name: a live tab's session looks dead
why: findDeadSession no longer checks the session's Web Lock before calling it a crash

name: pageshow does not beat
why: a page back from the back/forward cache stays marked clean until its next 5 s beat
find: /\ hbs' = IF Design = "plan" \/ cur[t] \notin started THEN hbs ELSE [hbs EXCEPT ![cur[t]] = "running"]

name: the claim keeps the record
why: findDeadSession reads the dead records but no longer deletes them, so a second load asks about the same crash again
find: IF x \in LockSuspects THEN "none" ELSE hbs[x]

name: the first beat is written outside the lock
why: startBeat writes the record at boot but the page takes its Web Lock only later (as when the lock was taken in the lazy chunk), so another tab that loads while this one boots slowly asks about a crash that did not happen
